title: The Arts Center

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: The Arts Center is operated by the Jamestown Fine Arts Association that has been in existence for over 50 years. The Center’s current facility was renovated in 2012 and features a 2000 sq. ft. exhibition space, a performance/stage area of approximately 400 sq. ft., and a classroom used for all media and for children’s classes. In 2009 the Arts Center added an annex called the Hansen Arts Studio, which includes a ceramics studio with a kiln corner, and a classroom. The Arts Center is in the process of developing a print shop on the lower level of the Hansen Arts Studio as well.
